title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 423 (Appeal to Supreme Court)

content.overview: A person aggrieved by an order of the Appellate Tribunal may appeal to the Supreme Court within sixty days, on a question of law.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A person aggrieved by an order of the Appellate Tribunal may appeal to the Supreme Court within sixty days, on a question of law.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The Supreme Court may condone a further period not exceeding sixty days. The appeal is confined to a question of law arising out of the order.
